preflightCorrection: The first read-only artifact construction included a forbidden nested perPiece quantity; it was removed before the single Receive POST. It was not a failed Receive and caused no persistence.
preservedLessons: LP001: production builder must include outer item quantity and perPiece array with matching length.
LP002: perPiece entries must not carry quantity as physical stock authority.

newLesson.rootCause: inventory-master-policy.normalizeLooseDetails reads color/stoneColor, while the production Loose Pearl builder sends pearlColor inside looseDetails; persistAssetComponents therefore receives no color value.
newLesson.whatAllowedIt: The controlled receive path validated the core Pearl identity but did not assert field-by-field persistence parity for optional Pearl detail fields.
newLesson.minimumFix: Align the proven Loose Pearl field mapping at the canonical normalization boundary and add a readback assertion; owner approval required before source change.
newLesson.preventionGate: Exact request-to-asset detail reconciliation for every client-required Loose Pearl field before official acceptance.
newLesson.test: Loose Pearl receive/readback test asserting pearlColor persistence from the production builder.
